steps.m: Jump the feet between the hands into a deep squat, feet and knees together, heels down
Twist to the right, wrap the left arm around the shins and bind behind the back
Release, twist to the left and bind

alignment: Keep the heels grounded and the knees together.
Lengthen the spine on the inhale and twist from the belly on the exhale.
Hook the armpit well over the outside of the knees before reaching for the bind.
modifications: Place a rolled mat or blanket under the heels.
Hold a strap between the hands, or twist with hands in prayer.

steps.m: Jump through; fold the right leg back beside the hip, lift the left leg straight up holding the foot with both hands; look up
Draw the leg toward the face, chin toward the shin
Lift the head
Jump through; fold the left leg back, lift the right leg; look up
Draw the leg toward the face, chin toward the shin
Lift the head

alignment: Keep both sit bones grounded.
Straighten the lifted leg first, then bring it closer.
Lengthen the spine toward the leg rather than rounding.
modifications: Loop a strap around the lifted foot.
Place a folded blanket under the straight-leg hip.

shalabhasana-a.note: Shalabhasana A and B share one count.

steps.m: Lower onto the belly, arms alongside the body, palms up; lift the chest and the legs
Place the palms under the shoulders and lift the chest and legs again

alignment: Keep the legs together and active, toes pointed.
Lengthen forward through the crown rather than crunching the neck.
Lift from the upper back; draw the belly in to protect the lower back.
modifications: Lift only the chest or only the legs.

alignment: Hands under the shoulders with the elbows hugging in.
Press lightly into the hands and lift with the back muscles.
modifications: Keep the legs on the floor.
Place a folded blanket under the hips.

steps.m: Lower onto the belly; bend the knees and place the hands on top of the feet, fingers forward; press the feet down and lift the chest

alignment: Point the fingers forward like the toes.
Lift the elbows up and the chest forward.
Press the heels toward the floor beside the hips.
modifications: One leg at a time (Ardha Bhekasana), propped on the opposite forearm.

steps.m: Lower onto the belly; bend the knees, hold the ankles and lift the chest and knees

alignment: Kick the feet into the hands to lift.
Keep the knees about hip-width; don't let them splay.
Broaden across the collarbones.
modifications: Use a strap around the ankles.
Lift one side at a time.

steps.m: Lower onto the belly, hold the ankles and lift into Dhanurasana
Roll onto the right side, keeping the bow
Roll back through center
Roll onto the left side
Roll back to center, then release

alignment: Keep kicking the feet into the hands as you roll.
Roll on the side of the ribs, not the shoulder.
modifications: Rock gently side to side without rolling all the way over.

steps.m: Jump through to kneeling, knees hip-width, hands on the hips
Lift the chest and arch back, taking the heels
Come up, leading with the chest

alignment: Keep the hips over the knees.
Lift the chest up before reaching back.
Lengthen the tailbone and keep the glutes soft.
modifications: Tuck the toes under to raise the heels.
Keep the hands on the lower back.

steps.m: Jump through to kneeling; hold the ankles
Arch back and lower the crown of the head to the floor
Use the strength of the thighs to come up

alignment: Keep the knees hip-width and the thighs strong.
Lower slowly with control.
Straighten the arms and lift the chest at the bottom.

kapotasana-a.note: Kapotasana A and B share one count.

steps.m: Jump through to kneeling, hands at the chest
Arch back, place the hands down and walk them to the heels; elbows on the floor
Straighten the arms and lift the head, hands on the floor
Come up to kneeling

alignment: Push the hips forward over the knees as you arch back.
Keep breathing smoothly; lift the chest toward the ceiling.
Elbows stay shoulder-width.
modifications: Lower to the crown of the head and pause there.
Use a wall or blocks for the hands.

alignment: Straighten the arms and lift the head, keeping the hips forward.
Spread the backbend evenly through the whole spine.

steps.m: Jump through to Padmasana and bind the toes behind the back (Baddha Padmasana)
Arch back and lower the crown of the head to the floor; repeat three times
Come up

alignment: Arch from the upper back while the knees stay down.
Traditionally practiced with a teacher holding the knees.
Lift the chest; release the head last.
modifications: Practice with the knees held by a teacher or anchored under a heavy bolster.

bakasana-a.note: Bakasana A and B share one count. A is entered from standing on the floor; B is jumped into from Down Dog.

steps.m: Step forward, place the knees on the backs of the upper arms and lift into Bakasana
Jump from Down Dog directly into Bakasana

alignment: Place the knees high, near the armpits.
Round the back and draw the belly in.
Straighten the arms over time; gaze slightly forward.
modifications: Place a block under the feet or a cushion in front of the face.

alignment: Jump light, bringing the hips high before the knees land.
Land the knees on the upper arms with control.

bharadvajasana.meaning: Twist dedicated to the sage Bharadvaja

steps.m: Jump through; fold the left shin back beside the hip and take the right foot into half lotus; twist right, bind the lotus foot behind the back, left hand under the right knee
Jump through and repeat on the other side, twisting left

alignment: Keep both sit bones as grounded as possible.
Lengthen up first, then twist from the belly.
Turn the head last.
modifications: Keep the lotus foot on the floor (no lotus) and hold the knee.

steps.m: Jump through; fold the left heel beside the right hip, step the right foot outside the left knee; twist right, left arm over the knee to hold the foot, right hand binding behind
Jump through and repeat on the other side, twisting left

alignment: Keep the spine vertical; lift through the crown.
Press the outer arm against the knee to deepen the twist.
Keep the standing foot flat.
modifications: Hug the knee instead of binding.

eka-pada-sirsasana.note: A: upright with hands in prayer. B: fold forward. C: lift up on the hands.

steps.m: Jump through; place the right leg behind the head, hands in prayer, look up (A)
Fold forward, chin toward the extended shin (B)
Come up, hands down and lift the body (C)
Jump through; left leg behind the head (A)
Fold forward (B)
Come up and lift (C)

alignment: Rotate the thigh outward from the hip before taking the leg back.
Draw the shoulder under the knee; keep the head and chest lifted.
Never pull on the knee joint.
modifications: Cradle the leg in the arms (baby cradle) instead.
Lie on the back to bring the foot toward the head.

steps.m: Jump through; place both legs behind the head, cross the ankles, balance on the sit bones with the hands in prayer
Place the hands down and lift the body off the floor

alignment: Take the first leg back fully before adding the second.
Lift the chest and press the head back into the feet.
Keep breathing smoothly.
modifications: Keep one leg behind the head (Eka Pada Sirsasana).

steps.m: Jump through; exhale and lie down on the back
Bring both legs behind the head, cross the ankles and bind the hands behind the back

alignment: Let gravity help. The back stays on the floor.
Draw the shoulders under the knees before crossing the ankles.
modifications: Hold the feet without taking them behind the head (happy baby).
Take one leg at a time.

tittibhasana-a.note: Tittibhasana A, B and C share one count. B is often followed by walking forward and back five steps.

steps.m: Jump the legs around the arms, straighten the legs forward and lift the chest
Lower the feet, fold forward and bind the hands behind the back, feet together
Release the bind and hold the ankles from behind, legs straightening
Hands down, lift back into Tittibhasana

alignment: Place the thighs high on the upper arms.
Press the floor away and lift the chest forward.
Keep the legs straight and toes pointed.
modifications: Keep the knees bent or the feet on the floor.
Practice B with the hands on the floor.

alignment: Fold deeply with the shoulders behind the knees.
Keep the feet together and the bind firm.
modifications: Hold a strap between the hands.
Keep the hands on the floor.

alignment: Draw the shoulders behind the legs.
Straighten the legs gradually.

steps.m: From Down Dog, lower the forearms, walk the feet in and lift the legs into a forearm balance

alignment: Keep the forearms parallel, elbows shoulder-width.
Push the floor away and lift the shoulders.
Draw the ribs in to avoid arching.
modifications: Use a strap around the upper arms or a block between the hands.

steps.m: From Down Dog, lift into Pincha Mayurasana
Fold the legs into Padmasana and lower the knees onto the upper arms
Lift the lotus back up to vertical, release the legs and lower down

alignment: Round the back as the lotus lowers.
Keep the shoulders over the elbows.
Exhale to lower, inhale to lift. The bandhas do the work.

steps.m: Jump the feet apart, place the hands between them with the fingers pointing back; elbows into the belly, extend the legs and lift

alignment: Elbows close together, pressing into the belly.
Lean forward to counterbalance the legs.
Body in one line, parallel to the floor.
modifications: Keep the toes on the floor.
Bend the knees or cross the legs in lotus.

steps.m: Holding Chaturanga, hop the whole body forward and back, five times

alignment: Keep the body in one straight line throughout.
Elbows hug the ribs.

steps.m: From Down Dog, take the right foot into half lotus and lower onto the right knee, left foot beside it; wrap the arms and lift the chest
Repeat with the left foot in half lotus

alignment: Keep the hips level and the spine vertical.
Lower the lotus knee down gently. Never drop onto it.
Squeeze the arms together and lift the elbows.
modifications: Keep the foot on the inner thigh instead of half lotus.

steps.m: Jump through; fold the right leg back beside the hip, extend the left leg out to the side; reach over and hold the left foot
Turn the chest up and fold sideways over the left leg; gaze up
Come up
Jump through; fold the left leg back, extend the right leg to the side
Fold sideways over the right leg
Come up

alignment: Rotate the chest toward the ceiling as you fold sideways.
Keep the extended leg straight, kneecap facing up.
modifications: Hold the shin instead of the foot.
Kneel on the folded leg instead of sitting.

gomukhasana-a.drishti: Nasagrai (tip of the nose); Urdhva (up) in B
gomukhasana-a.note: Gomukhasana A and B share one count.

steps.m: Jump through; cross the right knee over the left and sit between the heels; hands on the top knee, lift the chest
Bind the hands behind the back, right elbow up; look up
Jump through; cross the left knee over the right; hands on the knee
Bind with the left elbow up; look up

alignment: Stack the knees and keep both sit bones grounded.
Lift the chest and keep the spine upright.
Lift the top elbow toward the ceiling.
Keep the head neutral against the top arm.
modifications: Hold a strap between the hands.

steps.m: Jump through; exhale and lie down
Take the right foot into half lotus and bind it behind the back with the right hand; roll back over the shoulders
Roll up onto the left knee and twist, left hand on the floor
Roll back and change sides
Roll up and twist on the other side

alignment: Roll with momentum and keep the bind.
Keep the lotus knee soft; never force it.
modifications: Practice the twist seated with the lotus foot held.

mukta-hasta-sirsasana-a.note: A, B and C share one count. Arm positions vary between teachers.

steps.m: Crown of the head down; arms straight in front, palms down; lift the legs to vertical
Lower, reposition the arms out to the sides, and lift again
Lower, reach the arms straight back with the palms up, and lift again

alignment: Balance on the crown with a long neck. Lift through the legs.
Use strong bandhas to lift and lower with control.
Press the palms down to steady the balance.
Find the balance point on the crown before lifting.

baddha-hasta-sirsasana-a.note: A–D share one count. A is the classic headstand with interlaced fingers; arm positions for B–D vary between teachers.

steps.m: Interlace the fingers, crown down, lift the legs (A)
Lower; palms flat with the forearms parallel; lift (B)
Lower; fold the arms holding opposite elbows in front of the head; lift (C)
Lower; change the arm position; lift (D)

alignment: Press the forearms down and lift the shoulders.
Lift and lower the legs straight, using the bandhas.
modifications: Bend the knees to lift and lower.

alignment: Press the palms down evenly.
Keep the forearms pressing firmly into the floor.
Lift the shoulders away from the floor.
